mapper.sql: uc.*, m.code AS mat_code, m.name AS mat_name, fu.code AS from_uom_code, fu.name AS from_uom_name, tu.code AS to_uom_code, tu.name AS to_uom_name

FROM mdm_uom_conv uc LEFT JOIN mdm_mat m ON m.id = uc.mat_id AND m.deleted = 0 LEFT JOIN mdm_uom fu ON fu.id = uc.from_uom_id AND fu.deleted = 0 LEFT JOIN mdm_uom tu ON tu.id = uc.to_uom_id AND tu.deleted = 0
